## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle commentary on the *Fànwǎng jīng* bodhisattva-precepts by the great Silla-dynasty Korean Buddhist philosopher **Wǒnhyo** 元曉 ([元曉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E6%9B%89), 617–686). 私記 *sījì* "personal notes" indicates the genre — informal exegetical notes rather than a formal scholastic commentary.

**Abstract**

Wǒnhyo is the foundational systematic philosopher of Korean Buddhism, the author of the *Daśabhūmika-sūtra-vibhāṣā* commentary, the *Awakening of Faith* commentary (*Qǐxìn lùn shū* 起信論疏), and over seventy other works. His *Fànwǎng* commentary, though brief, is significant as one of the **three principal Silla** commentaries on the bodhisattva-precepts (alongside [義寂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BE%A9%E5%AF%82) Ŭijŏk's *Púsàjièběn shū* [KR6k0082](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0082) and [太賢](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A4%AA%E8%B3%A2) Taehyŏn's *Fànwǎngjīng gǔjì jì* [KR6k0083](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0083)). Wǒnhyo's distinctive **harmonising** (和諍 *hwajaeng*) interpretive method — reconciling apparently contradictory doctrinal positions — is applied to the *Fànwǎng* precepts to integrate the bodhisattva-precept tradition with both the Yogācāra and Madhyamaka philosophical frameworks.
